mainEntity.name: How do I balance modern comfort and energy efficiency with preserving original materials?

acceptedAnswer.text: Strategies include adding discreet insulation, weatherstripping, storm windows, and high‑efficiency systems while retaining visible historic components. Energy modeling and a whole-building approach help prioritize upgrades that deliver comfort and savings without unnecessary removal of original fabric.
